title: nidm-simulation-sel: simulation code of the selective contact reduction study (selcor-v1.0)
description: Agent-based simulation of selective contact reduction during disease outbreaks, extending the Networking during Infectious Diseases Model (NIDM). The simulation output archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24561685 was produced by build 70dcf43 of this code; later commits change documentation and repository files only, not the code.
